subject: general
question: DAY-NRLM observed the 'Agri Nutri Garden Week' from 10th to 17th January 2022 through awareness campaigns and encouraged establishment of 'Agri Nutri Gardens' in the rural households. What is the full form of DAY-NRLM?

options.text: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Level Meet
Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission
Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Living Mission
Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Meet

solution:
The correct answer is __**Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission**__.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• DAY-NRLM celebrates Agri Nutri Garden Week as part of **Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav.**
 
• DAY-NRLM observed the 'Agri Nutri Garden Week' from 10th to 17th January 2022 through awareness campaigns and encouraged establishment of **'Agri Nutri Gardens' **in the rural households.
 
• It is the Mission’s agenda to support every rural poor household to have Agri Nutri Garden to fulfill the need of the family’s nutrition and any excess production can also be sold for income generation.
 
• A total of **76,664** ‘Agri Nutri Gardens’ were established in this week against the target of **7500.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav is an initiative of the Government of India to celebrate and commemorate 75 years of independence and the glorious history of it's people, culture and achievements.
 
• In the Agri Nutri Garden project organic nutritional gardens are set up at households to make available nutritious vegetables and fruits, prepare them to become self-sufficient in vegetables and thereby create a healthy society
 
• **Shri Giriraj Singh** has taken charge as the Union Minister of Rural Development and Panchayati Raj.
